name: LSH
recent: LSH Capital 于2026年10月8日从创业板转至主板上市，并提议在吉隆坡塔广场建设缆车连接主要景点。近期多位董事（包括执行副主席 Datuk Lim Keng Guan 和执行董事 Lim Ding Shyong）在闭门期多次申报增持股份。
notable: 公司于2026年10月8日完成从创业板转至主板上市。
公司提议在吉隆坡塔广场建设缆车，连接主要景点。
执行副主席 Datuk Lim Keng Guan 和执行董事 Lim Ding Shyong 在2026年10月至11月期间多次增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为1.127亿令吉，环比增长13.4%，但同比下降7.5%；净利为1497万令吉，环比下降19.5%，同比下降42.7%；净利率为13.3%，低于上一季度的18.7%。

recent_en: LSH Capital transferred its listing from ACE Market to Main Market on 8 October 2026 and proposed a cable car linking KL Tower Square to key attractions. Recently, several directors (including Executive Vice Chairman Datuk Lim Keng Guan and Executive Director Lim Ding Shyong) reported multiple acquisitions of shares during the closed period.
notable_en: The company completed its transfer from ACE Market to Main Market on 8 October 2026.
The company proposed a cable car at KL Tower Square linking key attractions.
Executive Vice Chairman Datuk Lim Keng Guan and Executive Director Lim Ding Shyong acquired shares multiple times between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR112.7 million, up 13.4% QoQ but down 7.5% YoY; net income was MYR15.0 million, down 19.5% QoQ and 42.7% YoY; net margin was 13.3%, lower than 18.7% in the previous quarter.
